DECISION: Use a dual-mode system with a true high-contrast light theme and a high-contrast dark theme, each with adjustable font scaling and saturation—test glare and readability with users who have astigmatism or color vision deficiency.

Result: A single interface that adapts to glare and accessibility needs without sacrificing consistency.
